name: @jsfkit/utils
description: A collection of utilities for working with JSF: a JSON spreadsheet representation

scripts.build:docs: typedoc && concat-md tempdocs > API.md && rm -rf tempdocs
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck
scripts.release: PACKAGE_VERSION=$(jq -r .version package.json) && echo "About to tag and push v$PACKAGE_VERSION. Continue? (y/n)" && read -r REPLY && [ "$REPLY" = "y" ] && git tag --annotate v$PACKAGE_VERSION --message=v$PACKAGE_VERSION && git push origin v$PACKAGE_VERSION
